criteria.title: Formal regression and direct handoff review
Native preservation and Responses complete handoff

observations.summary: Formal offline regressions reproduced a lost receipt on service restart and an undispatched operation running under another turn. Source recreation with SQLite now preserves ownership, exact output and at-most-once invocation; crossed turn and unknown settlement are rejected before dispatch.

The provider wire fixture verified three declared app functions, actual final-response actions and the advertised digest. A qualified standalone control retained its ordinary Host admission; mixed and private calls were rejected. The retained Dome source reproduced a single 960 by 1280 view with exact original retention.

Source selection and native continuation passed. The offline Responses successor distinguishes undeclared direct calls from recoverable Host admission failures and accepts a valid call without starting another conversation.

Focused native, Responses and Core fixtures exercised search to import, provider media and source identity, standalone control routing, correction, restart and known execution without discovery. The recorded Dome draft created one group and 411 vectors.
Scoped offline Host, source and adapter checks passed. The implemented wire tools array measured 16,020 bytes including provider web search. No hosted inference or billing measurement.
